name: Transaction Details 187
definition: Identifies additional details of the transaction.

TransactionActivity.name: Transaction Activity
TransactionActivity.definition: Specifies the type of activity to which this instruction relates.

SettlementTransactionOrCorporateActionEv.name: Settlement Transaction Or Corporate Action Event Type
SettlementTransactionOrCorporateActionEv.definition: Choice of type for the transaction reported.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which a trade transaction has been executed.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

PlaceOfClearing.name: Place Of Clearing
PlaceOfClearing.definition: Infrastructure which may be a component of a clearing house and which facilitates clearing and settlement for its members by standing between the buyer and the seller. It may net transactions and it substitutes itself as settlement counterparty for each position.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instruments representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

CountryOfIssue.name: Country Of Issue
CountryOfIssue.definition: Primary market or country where a security is issued by the issuer or its agent.

ConditionalSecuritiesDelivery.name: Conditional Securities Delivery
ConditionalSecuritiesDelivery.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is under Conditional Securities Delivery (CoSD).

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of financial instrument to be settled.

SettledQuantity.name: Settled Quantity
SettledQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument effectively settled and which will be delivered to/received from the account owner's securities account. It may differ from the instructed settlement quantity based on market tolerance level.

PreviouslySettledQuantity.name: Previously Settled Quantity
PreviouslySettledQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument previously settled.

RemainingToBeSettledQuantity.name: Remaining To Be Settled Quantity
RemainingToBeSettledQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument remaining to be settled.

NumberOfDaysAccrued.name: Number Of Days Accrued
NumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Number of days on which the interest rate accrues (daily accrual note).

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

RemainingSettlementAmount.name: Remaining Settlement Amount
RemainingSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money remaining to be settled.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

EffectiveSettlementDate.name: Effective Settlement Date
EffectiveSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which a transaction is completed and cleared, that is a payment is effected and securities are delivered.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time assets become available to the account owner (in a credit entry), or cease to be available to the account owner (in a debit entry).

StatusDate.name: Status Date
StatusDate.definition: Date and time at which the status was assigned.

AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.name: Acknowledged Status Time Stamp
AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is acknowledged.

MatchedStatusTimeStamp.name: Matched Status Time Stamp
MatchedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is matched.

Linkages.name: Linkages
Linkages.definition: Link to another transaction that must be processed after, before or at the same time.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

ReversalIndicator.name: Reversal Indicator
ReversalIndicator.definition: Specifies whether it is the reversal of a previously reported movement.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

TransactionAdditionalDetails.name: Transaction Additional Details
TransactionAdditionalDetails.definition: Provides additional details on the transaction which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

PostingAmountRule.definition: If the instruction is against payment, PostingAmount must be present.|.

AdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the sender and receiver, if TransactionAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosing1Rule.definition: For settlement of two parts transactions (Securities Financing), the opening/initiation and closing/return of the transaction is confirmed by sending the below combination of SecuritiesMovementType codes and SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType codes:||Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: Repo (REPU)|Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: Repo (REPU)||Reverse Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)|Reverse Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)||TriParty Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyRepo (TRPO)|TriParty Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyRepo (TRPO)||TriParty Reverse Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyReverseRepo (TRVO)|TriParty Reverse Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: TriPartyReverseRepo (TRVO)||Securities Lending Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)|Securities Lending Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)||Securities Borrowing Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB)|Securities Borrowing Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB).

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosing2Rule.definition: For settlement of two parts transactions (buy-sell back, sell buy-back, collateral in and out), the opening/initiation and closing/return of the transaction is confirmed by sending the below combination of SecuritiesMovementType codes and SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType codes:||Sell-Buy Back: Sell|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)|Sell-Buy Back: Buy Back|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: SellBuyBack (SBBK)||Buy-Sell Back: Buy|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)|Buy-Sell Back: Sell Back|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: BuySellBack (BSBK)||Collateral (giver) Out Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)|Collateral (giver) Out Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralOut (COLO)||Collateral (taker) In Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI)|Collateral (taker) In Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SettlementParameters/SecuritiesTransactionType: CollateralIn (COLI).
